conclusions.confirmed_template_shortcut: Mixed official topics occur only in missing negatives; no positive with irrelevant wrong-topic official and no uniform wrong-topic negative.
conclusions.declared_scope_limit: Answer states always have one applicable official; two current same-scope officials are always conflicting. Full agreement reasoning is not measured.
conclusions.not_a_fault_by_itself: Official authority, query product/plan, relevant validity and budget after insufficiency are required task semantics; making them independent of labels would corrupt the task.
conclusions.caution: Train/dev feature correlations and this deterministic rule do not show which shortcut, if any, the current model learned.
